text:
jen_sales: @priya quick heads-up — NovaHealth wants a POC but they insist on EU-only write affinity and BYO-KMS with keys in their EU tenant. they asked: can requests ever fall back to US? and which sub-processors touch EU data?
priya_presales: noted. do they require hard block (no cross-border failover) or soft preference?
jen_sales: they said 'no cross-border egress for patient data' — legal will audit. they're ok with read-only caching outside EU as long as write path stays in EU.
luca_eng: short answer: hosted mode today can be configured with regional routing but we currently allow automated fallback to nearest compatible capacity (often US) when EU capacity is exhausted. that would violate hard block.
priya_presales: can we run the POC on Dedicated or Private to guarantee no US fallback?
luca_eng: yes — Dedicated pinned GPU pools (or Private VPC) can be configured with strict region pinning and no cross-region failover. lower latency predictability but ensures data residency.
oli_infra: @jen_sales FYI Dedicated requires a reserved capacity contract; provisioning lead ~10 business days once order in. network peering and certs add ~3-5 days.
marta_legal: NovaHealth will need our EU sub-processor list and a subprocessor attestation. @security_bot do we have the per-region subproc CSV link?
security_bot: /links/subprocessors_by_region.csv — latest upload 2026-02-05. EU list: cloud-hosting-eu, logging-eu (managed vendor), metrics-eu. note: some monitoring infra uses global shards but no customer data is routed outside EU for Dedicated/Private.
priya_presales: perfect — i'll attach that in the security questionnaire. jen: they asked about BYO-KMS: can customer KMS (in AWS eu-west-1) hold keys so ciphertext never leaves EU?
luca_eng: BYO-KMS in customer account is supported for Private and in Dedicated via customer key provisioning when using regional keystore. hosted public offering can't guarantee key residency today (keys are in our managed KMS regions).
jen_sales: pricing question: any est for Dedicated delta vs hosted for this POC (1-2k qps spikes)?
oli_infra: rough: Dedicated small pool baseline ~ $12k/month + one-time setup $5k for pinning+peering. can tighten after we profile.
priya_presales: note to self: include optional hourly burst for traffic spikes (if they prefer hosted burst, that defeats residency need).
marta_legal: also need to confirm contractual SLA for no-cross-border — that's an exception and will need SOC/DPAs updated. timeline for legal review ~7 business days once we submit draft.
jen_sales: next steps = 1) share subproc CSV + BYO-KMS caveat 2) propose Dedicated quote + lead times 3) schedule technical sync with NovaHealth + infra + presales. can we have draft quote and docs by EOD tomorrow?
priya_presales: i'll draft quote and a concise one-pager summarizing residency guarantees and limitations.
luca_eng: i'll open internal ticket to track routing-policy change request (ticket INF-4821) — estimate 2 weeks dev+test to add enforcement flag for hosted fallback (but we can avoid by using Dedicated).
oli_infra: I'll block tentative provisioning window week-after-next in case they greenlight.
marta_legal: i'll prep subproc attestation and flag any additional clauses needed.
jen_sales: thanks team — I'll forward to NovaHealth and book a sync for Tue. :thumbsup:
priya_presales: tagging checklist: [subproc CSV, BYO-KMS note, Dedicated quote, provisioning ETA, legal DPA draft]. will post updates in this thread.
security_bot: reminder: for any BYO-KMS flow include key rotation SOP and key revocation steps in the handoff docs.
jen_sales: copypasta for customer email: "We can guarantee EU write residency with a Dedicated or Private deployment. BYO-KMS is supported in EU for those modes; hosted public cannot guarantee EU-only keys today. Subprocessor list attached. Provisioning lead ~10 business days after order." will send after priya's quote.
priya_presales: sounds good — i'll upload quote + packet here when ready.
jen_sales: closing for now, will re-open after customer sync.
